name: 9Router
description: A gateway for AI coding tools: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Cline and Copilot send their requests to one endpoint, and 9Router routes them across the providers and accounts you add, with fallback when one is rate-limited and usage per key. Its dashboard and settings live on the data volume.

access.note: The dashboard asks for one password and no account name: the generated INITIAL_PASSWORD from the Variables tab, for as long as no other password has been set in the dashboard's settings (once one is, that one is the credential). Provider accounts and the API keys your tools use are added there.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Optional; the endpoint your tools are pointed at; nothing else here changes when it does.

ports.name: http
ports.purpose: The dashboard and the OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints

volumes.name: data
volumes.purpose: Providers, accounts, API keys and usage

update.notes: 9Router releases often; read the release notes before updating and back up the data volume.

secrets.name: password
secrets.label: Dashboard password
secrets.description: The dashboard password until another is set in its settings.

secrets.name: key-secret
secrets.label: API key secret
secrets.description: Derives the API keys 9Router issues; changing it invalidates them.

secrets.name: machine-salt
secrets.label: Machine id salt
secrets.description: Salts the machine id 9Router reports to providers.
